propertySets.name: Pset_CommunicationsApplianceTypeOpticalNetworkUnit
propertySets.definition: Properties common to a optical network unit. This property set is applied to a type or occurrence of IfcCommunicationsAppliance with predefined type OPTICAL_NETWORK_UNIT.

properties.name: OpticalNetworkUnitType
properties.definition: Indicates the type of the optical network unit equipment.

properties.name: NumberOfInterfaces
properties.definition: Indicates the types of interfaces and their number in the device.
